title: 出世すごろく ～UP & DOWN～
tagline: ふって、すすんで、のぼったり、おりたり。
coreMechanic: Equal-probability dice across an original 100-cell serpentine board; one promotion/transfer per move; exact100 goal

inputs.roll: PC click / Space / Enter; phone tap

rules.events: one only; no chain; none after100
rules.standings: finished players skipped; final remaining player assigned last rank without more dice

practice: Optional dedicated two-roll lesson, actual model at clearly labeled practice positions; fixed die2 demonstrates transfer and promotion; no RUN, BEST, statistics or production telemetry
storage: Save_version1 atomic state replayed from move history; pending die retained across pause/reload; explicit resume; local result UUID ledger separate from nullable observer RUN UUID; memoryOnly after denied writes
jev: development-only Shadow on findings; never gameplay or release approval
humanReview: author subjective and physical-device playtest pending
telemetry: game_open/run_start/run_end/retry/pause/resume/return_to_portal and specific_game_events dice_roll/promotion/transfer/finish; practice production excluded; remoteCollectionEnabled:false pending Worker registration
